architecture.merge_policy: never downgrade valid pregame data; freeze at live/final
architecture.bullpen: workload.bullpen_availability() + direct raw-pitches reliever workload query with leverage heuristic
architecture.starter_workload: model BF assumption from generated games.html + external research comparison
architecture.consensus_market: report-layer external intelligence file; odds.py remains single-book
architecture.edge_deterioration: model total vs first preserved pipeline quote vs current consensus
architecture.external_intelligence: mandatory research step in Daily Intelligence Brief
architecture.manager_media: timestamped research passes + declarations + freshness + computed reconciliation; preserved pregame
architecture.previous_game_postgame: previous game's postgame comments and carry-forward availability/tactical intelligence; external research layer
